submission.justification: Module-D2 has the highest light yield but fails the robustness requirement: 30% of modules failed thermal cycling, against a limit of 5%. The modules can't be reached once the cryostat is filled, so D2 is excluded. Of the two remaining designs, D1 collects more light than D3 at 30% coverage (37.3 vs 25.0 PE/MeV). D1 failed 2% of modules, which is within the limit. Light collection rises with coverage, and the feedthroughs support up to 30%.

requirements.evidence: D1 at 30% gives 37.3 PE/MeV. This is the highest among the designs that pass robustness. D2 would give more, but it is excluded.
D1 failed 2% of modules. D2 failed 30%, so it was excluded. D3 failed 0.5%.

requirements.requirement: One of the three listed designs

requirements.evidence: 30%. The meeting notes confirm enough feedthroughs for up to 30%.
